object.description: Build CHILD -> PARENT -> GRAND by links, and SIB linking to PARENT, all committed and acknowledged. Change GRAND, SIB and CHILD; then revise GRAND and commit, and give PARENT a validation error; then close a link cycle back to CHILD; then break GRAND's manifest. Enter a tag name in CHILD's commit dialog each time. Expected: no warning for the clean chain; then 'GRAND — uncommitted changes' only; then PARENT's uncommitted change, suspect link and validation error; CHILD is never its own upstream; GRAND is named as not loading. The warnings show only while a tag name is entered and Commit stays enabled.
